page.layout: One printed page: one column of running text, full width. Below the text, a catchword at the right. Faint stray marks at the lower left and lower right are not legible as text. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: dum aliquid, quod mutari fit nefas: Romanos sanè facere id, quod eos deceat, quum miserorum hominum precibus aequitatis speciem habentibus morem gerant: sed ubi edocti ab aliquo fuerint, eorum, quae petuntur, alia fieri haud posse, alia ingens dedecus cum detrimento sociis & amicis ipsorum inferre; non solere eos pertinacius agere, & ad vim se conferre: nec credibile, sui dissimiles eos in hac re esse futuros: quinimo putandum, ubi cognoverint, non posse nos petitioni eorum locum dare, nisi jusjurandum, leges, sædera columnis inscripta, quibus communis nostra respublica continetur, violamus, discessuros propositio suo, & arbitraturos, justam nos causam habere, cur moras nectamus, nec eorum petitioni statim morem geramus. Sed obniti sententiae huic praetor Hyperbatus & Callicrates Leontesius, & contendere summopere, sine morâ faciendum, quod peteretur à Romanis, nec voluntati horum ullam legem, ullum columnae impressum sædus, aut omnino quicquam aliud esse anteferendum. Quam ob causam cum in diversa irent concilii sententiae, placuit tandem legatos mittere Romam, qui de his, quae dicta à Lycortâ erant, senatus mentem exquirerent.

page.notes: Running head is printed in capitals with a V for U ("LACONVM"), normalised to "LACONUM" under the u/v rule. The catchword "Sta." is at the right foot. The bottom-right line contains partly Greek-looking letters ending in "Lyc" and is too faint to read; it is transcribed as illegible. The faint marks at the lower left are not legible text. The right edge carries fragments of the neighbouring page (e.g. partial letters beside "ullam legem") and red rules, which are not transcribed. The long s is printed as f in "fine" and "impressum"; it is transcribed as plain s ("sine", "impressum"). The paragraph runs unbroken from the top of the page to the catchword: no new indent appears.
